subject: Upcoming Company Picnic - RSVP Required
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual company picnic is coming up on Saturday, August 15th at Central Park. Please make sure to RSVP by next Friday, August 7th, so we can finalize the catering and activities. This year, we have planned fun games, delicious food, and great prizes for all attendees. We look forward to seeing you all there and having a great time together! Best regards, [Your Name]
